providers.operation: Optimize one Matérn32 coordinate length and optionally amplitude with analytic gradients.

parameters.errors: Aligned finite strictly positive error vector.
parameters.lengths: Finite positive vector matching coordinate width; units match coordinates.
parameters.optimized_axis: Python integer selecting one coordinate axis.
parameters.metric_log_bounds: Increasing finite two-vector bounding log(length squared).
parameters.amplitude_log_radius: Finite positive radius around initial log-amplitude.
parameters.white_noise_variance: Finite strictly positive scalar white variance.

providers.validity_bounds: Freeze all other lengths. Use george likelihood/gradient and scipy bounded minimize without an extra iteration cap or restarts. On optimizer failure restore initial active parameters while retaining optimizer.x separately, even if diagnostic values are nonfinite. No jitter repair.

providers.reuse: Generic response/error operation; no coordinate or astronomy policy.

Twenty-four providers expose generic GP, reference grouping, class balancing and multiclass ensemble operations alongside explicit astronomy lifecycle policy. Published Matern32 is reused. Original, derivative, old provider and kernel histories are preserved.
